_notes: Moveable Islamic dates are expected dates (moon sighting can shift by 1 day). Update the 'dates' lists each year. Fixed events use 'recurring' as MM-DD.

events.name: Shab-e-Barat
events.hook: Shab-e-Barat is near, and many Bengali families prepare halwa and ruti to share with neighbours.

events.name: Ramadan
events.hook: With Ramadan approaching, families across East London are planning their iftar tables.

events.name: Pohela Falgun
events.hook: Pohela Falgun welcomes spring in Bengali culture with colour, gatherings and festive food.

events.name: Ekushey February
events.hook: On 21 February, Bengali communities across London gather to honour the language movement.

events.name: Mothering Sunday
events.hook: Mothering Sunday is a lovely reason to gather the family around a home cooked meal.

events.name: Eid ul-Fitr
events.hook: Eid is just around the corner, the perfect time to plan your family feast.

events.name: Independence Day
events.hook: On 26 March, Bangladeshi families and community groups in London come together to celebrate Independence Day.

events.name: Pohela Boishakh
events.hook: Pohela Boishakh, the Bengali New Year, is a celebration of culture, community and food.

events.name: Wedding Season
events.hook: Wedding season is almost here, and good caterers fill their diaries early.

events.name: Eid ul-Adha
events.hook: Eid ul-Adha is almost here, a time for sharing, giving and gathering around good food.

events.name: Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi
events.hook: Milad gatherings bring families and communities together for dua, remembrance and shared food.

events.name: Winter
events.hook: As the cold sets in across London, nothing beats warming Bengali comfort food.

events.name: Victory Day
events.hook: On 16 December, Bangladeshi communities in London come together to remember and celebrate Victory Day.

events.name: Christmas and New Year
events.hook: December is full of office parties and family get-togethers, and halal guests deserve a proper feast.
